tripNote: Closed Monday 23 Nov; book well ahead for the weekend.

tripNote: Fri/Sat evenings and Sat/Sun are busy; book ahead if you want the biryani at dinner.

name: Dishoom Manchester
blurb: Bombay-cafe style Indian restaurant on Bridge Street, known for its lamb shank Nalli Nihari Biryani.
hoursNote: Hours from dishoom.com/manchester.

tripNote: Open evenings only; Sunday opens at 16:00.
tip: Famous for the giant naans; expect a queue on Fri/Sat nights, so book (01618 347222).
name: Akbar's Manchester

hoursNote: Hours from akbars.co.uk/restaurants; evening-only.
